# SpecMirror

> AI-powered side-by-side translator that turns plain-English product briefs into precise PRDs and engineering specs.

SpecMirror helps product managers, founders, and technical leads convert fuzzy product ideas into structured technical specs — covering architecture, auth strategy, data models, API surface, and infrastructure — with confidence scoring and encrypted sharing.
